title: It's for those who feel professionally stuck: Nadella on Microsoft's exit offer | 'This is a time of tumult' | Inshorts

It's for those who feel professionally stuck: Nadella on Microsoft's exit offer 
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone It's for those who feel professionally stuck: Nadella on Microsoft's exit offer
 short by Vaishnavi Mishra / 03:33 pm on Tuesday, 17 November 2026 Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella defended the company’s voluntary exit offer to more than 60,000 employees. He said the buyout gave employees who felt professionally stuck an opportunity to make conscious career decisions. "This voluntary thing was mostly about...[giving] everybody more agency to get themselves slotted into places that make sense for their economic opportunity long term," he said. read more at Hindustan Times Inshorts Pte.
